description: Server cache, URL state, form state, local UI state, subtree context, shared client state, flows. Classify first, then pick the tool.
Moving state up only when needed: local → lifted → URL or Context → external store. Each step adds reach and cost.
A query library for server data, a small client store, URL state, local state and a form library.
Anything computable from existing state (totals, filtered lists, validity). Compute it; never store it.
